items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: The interviewer addresses 'Dick' directly ('Anything else to add, Dick?'), but the interviewee (Sherwood Mangiapane) does not respond to Dick, nor does he mention Dick in any personal capacity. The interviewee's only spoken lines are directed at the interviewer or general comments.

ctx.x: Yeah, 634 St. Peter, the starving artist shop, I want to get it on the tape.
And this is Dick Allen, Bill, you give your name. Yeah, Bill Russell, and we're interviewing-
Sure would manage your pain. Do you have to talk? No, no, no. Just pick it up. Oh, I see.
